title: Air Force lieutenant colonel makes Marines sign an NDA and threatens execution

tellings.quote: And then um he told me flat out that if you talk about this, you can go to prison or you can be executed over it.

plain: Around 2009 or 2010, at Camp Hansen on Okinawa, Japan, an Air Force lieutenant colonel made a group of Marines sign a top-secret non-disclosure agreement about what they had seen in Indonesia, and warned them that "if you talk about this, you can go to prison or you can be executed over it." Michael Herrera, one of those Marines, tells Michels he was there and signed it, and he tells it because he says what they saw in Indonesia was a 300-foot UFO in the jungle. If true, it would show how hard the military worked to keep such a sighting quiet.
